blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Sparse AutoEncoders ( SAE s) offer a promising way to inspect language model representations, but it is still unclear what kind of linguistic structure their latents expose. We use part-of-speech ( PoS ) categories as a controlled test case to study whether morpho-syntactic information is encoded by individual latents or by structured groups of features. We find that PoS distinctions are highly recoverable from SAE activations, but do not align with one-to-one latent / category mappings. This recoverability is not reducible to lexical memorisation, and Open and Closed PoS classes differ substantially. Categories are supported by compact groups of sparse latents, with substantial variation across tags. These groups remain stable on held-out data, while also showing overlap between related categories. Our results show that SAEs localise morpho-syntactic information in a distributed and category-dependent form rather than through atomic grammatical features. 1 1 1 Code and Data available here: https://github.com/colinglab/pos-sae-latents .
blocks.zh: Sparse AutoEncoders(SAE s)为检查语言模型表达方式提供了一个很有希望的方法,但目前仍不清楚其潜质暴露在何种语言结构中. 我们使用部分语义(PoS)分类作为受控测试案例,研究是否由单个潜伏物或结构化特征组编码的morpho-syntatic信息. 我们发现,PoS区分从SAE激活中可以高度恢复,但与一对一的潜在/类映射不相符。 这种可回收性不能降低为词汇记忆,开放和封闭的PoS类差别很大. 类别由稀有潜质的紧凑组支撑,不同标记之间差异很大。 这些类别在搁置数据上保持稳定,同时也显示出相关类别之间的重叠。 我们的结果显示,SAEs以分布和类别依赖的形式而不是通过原子语法特征来本地化morpho-yntatic信息. 1 1 1 代码和数据请参见:https://github.com/colinglab/pos-sae-latents 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) encode a wide range of linguistic regularities in their internal representations, from lexical and syntactic information to more abstract semantic and discourse-level properties. Yet, despite substantial progress in probing and representation analysis, it remains unclear how such information is organized internally, for instance whether linguistic categories correspond to localized and interpretable units, or they are instead distributed across many dimensions of the representation space Elhage et al. (2022) . This question has become particularly relevant with the growing use of Sparse AutoEncoders ( SAE s) as tools for interpreting LLMs Bricken et al. (2023) ; Cunningham et al. (2023) ; Templeton et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)在其内部表述中编码了广泛的语言规律,从词汇学和合成信息到更抽象的语义和语义层次属性. 然而,尽管在探测和表述分析方面取得了很大进展,但目前仍不清楚这类信息如何在内部组织,例如,语言类别是否与本地化和可解释的单位相对应,或者它们分布在Elhage等人(2022年)的表述空间的许多层面。 随着越来越多地使用Sparse AutoEncoders(SAE s)作为解释LLMs Bricken等人(2023年);Cunningham等人(2023年);Templeton等人(2024年)的工具,这一问题变得特别重要。

blocks.en: SAE s aim to decompose dense model activations into high-dimensional sparse representations, where individual dimensions (aka latents ) are expected to capture more interpretable directions of variation. SAE latents are expected to provide a bridge between low-level model activations and human-interpretable features. This has motivated their use in mechanistic interpretability, where they are often discussed in terms of feature discovery and monosemanticity Elhage et al. (2022) ; Bricken et al. (2023) ; Templeton et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: SAE旨在将密集的模型激活分解为高维稀疏的表示,其中单个维度(aka points)预计将捕捉到更可解释的变异方向. SAE潜伏物预计将为低级模型激活和人类可解释特性提供桥梁。 这促使它们被用于机械解释,经常从特征发现和单质论的角度加以讨论。 Elhage等人(2022年);Bricken等人(2023年);Templeton等人(2024年)。

blocks.en: However, the relationship between SAE latents and linguistic categories is still not clear. In fact, the latter result from the combinations of multiple lexical, morphological, syntactic, and distributional features, which need not correspond to individual isolated latents. Understanding whether linguistic abstractions are localized or distributed in SAE spaces is thus important for evaluating what kind of interpretability SAE s provide Kantamneni et al. (2025) ; Karvonen et al. (2025) ; Engels et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 然而,SAE潜伏物与语言类别之间的关系仍然不明确. 事实上,后者是由多种语法、形态学、合成和分布特征的组合而成,这些特征不需要与个别孤立的潜伏物对应。 因此,了解语言抽象是本地化的还是在SAE空间中分布,对于评价何种解释性SAE s提供Kantamneni等人(2025年);Karvonen等人(2025年);Engels等人(2025年)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the workflow. We test PoS recoverability from token-level SAE activations, identify and compact PoS -relevant latent groups, and validate them on held-out and controlled data.
blocks.zh: 图1:工作流程概览。 我们测试PoS从符号级SAE激活的可回收性,确定和压缩PoS相关潜在组,并在搁置和控制数据上加以验证。

blocks.en: In this paper, we study this question by targeting part-of-speech ( PoS ) categories. PoS tags offer a controlled testbed for analyzing morpho-syntactic abstraction: They are discrete, independently annotated, and linguistically interpretable, while also differing in frequency, lexical openness, and syntactic function. For instance, open-class categories such as nouns and verbs are lexically productive and highly variable, whereas closed-class categories such as determiners, conjunctions, and pronouns are more restricted and often tied to specific syntactic roles. This makes PoS a useful setting for testing whether SAE latents behave as localized linguistic features or instead participate in broader distributed representations.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们通过针对部分言论(PoS)类别来研究这一问题。 PoS标签提供了一个可控测试台,用于分析morpho-yntatic抽象: 它们是离散的,独立附加说明的,在语言上可以解释的,同时也在频率,词汇开放,和合成功能上有所不同. 例如,名词和动词等开放阶级类别在逻辑学上是生产性的,而且有很大的可变性,而决定者,组合,代词等封闭阶级类别则受到更多的限制,并常常与特定的合成角色联系在一起. 这使得PoS成为一个有用的环境,用于测试SAE潜伏体是否表现为局部语言特征,或者参与更广泛的分布式表述.

blocks.en: We analyze SAE activations extracted from LLaMA-3-8B Grattafiori et al. (2024) on the GUM Corpus Treebank Zeldes (2017) . For each token, we encode its SAE representation into a sparse activation vector and study how gold Universal Dependencies ( UD ) PoS tags are represented in this latent space. Our experimental design follows a three-step interpretability pipeline: i.) we use binary probing classifiers to test whether individual PoS distinctions are recoverable from SAE activations Belinkov (2022) ; ii.) we use feature-salience analysis to rank the latents most relevant to each PoS category, and coverage analysis to estimate how many of these latents are needed to account for most instances of the category; iii.) we validate the selected latent groups on held-out and controlled data , and test whether their union is sufficient to train a multi-class PoS classifier.
blocks.zh: 我们分析LLaMA-3-8B Grattafiori等人(2024年)在GUM Corpus Treebank Zeldes(2017年)上提取的SAE激活. 对于每个符号,我们将其SAE的表示编码成一个稀疏的激活矢量,并研究黄金通用依赖(UD) PoS标记如何在这个潜在空间中体现. 我们的实验设计遵循一个三步可解释性管道:(一) 我们使用二进制测试分类器来测试单个的PoS区分是否能从SAE激活Belinkov(2022年)中恢复; (二) 我们使用特征显著分析来划分与每个PoS类别最相关的潜伏性,并进行覆盖分析来估计需要多少这些潜伏性来说明该类别的大多数情况; (三) 我们验证被搁置和控制数据上选定的潜伏组,并测试它们的结合是否足以训练一个多级的PoS分类器.

blocks.en: This setup allows us to move beyond standard probing accuracy. A high probing score may show that PoS information is present in SAE activations, but it does not explain how this information is organized Hewitt and Liang (2019) ; Pimentel et al. (2020) ; Belinkov (2022) . By combining probing, salience, coverage, compact-feature classification, and held-out validation, we can understand whether PoS categories are associated with individual monosemantic latents or with structured groups of sparse latents. We also examine whether different PoS categories are represented by different numbers of latents, which might suggest that the SAE representation reflects differences in the linguistic nature of the categories themselves.
blocks.zh: 这种设置使我们能够超越标准的测试精度. 一个高的探测分数可能表明PoS信息存在于SAE激活中,但它并没有解释这些信息是如何组织Hewitt和Liang(2019年);Pimentel等人(2020年);Belinkov(2022年). 通过结合探险,显要,覆盖,紧凑的地貌分类,以及搁置的验证,我们可以理解PoS类是与单个单语潜质相关联,还是与结构化的稀有潜质组相关联. 我们还审查不同的PoS类别是否以不同数量的潜伏物为代表,这可能表明SAE代表反映了类别本身语言性质的不同。

blocks.en: We address three research questions: (i) RQ1: Are PoS categories explicitly encoded in SAE latent activations? (ii) RQ2: What is the organization of the PoS categories encoding in the SAE latent spaces ? (iii) RQ3: How stable and systematic are these latent representations across linguistic categories, datasets, and evaluation settings?
blocks.zh: 我们处理三个研究问题:(一) RQ1:PoS类别是否明确编码为SAE潜在激活? (二) RQ2:在SAE潜在空间中如何组织PoS类编码? (三) RQ3:这些潜在表述在语言类别、数据集和评价环境中是否稳定和系统?

blocks.en: Our study makes two main contributions. First, we show that PoS categories are aligned with structured groups of sparse features . Through feature-salience and coverage analyses, we quantify the size and organization of these groups, show that it varies substantially across categories, and highlight differences between Open- and Closed-class PoS classes. Second, we show that these latent groups are compact yet effective : Their union preserves strong multi-class PoS classification performance, and they remain stable on held-out data, while still exhibiting overlap across related categories.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究作出了两项主要贡献。 第一,我们显示,方案支助类别与结构化的稀有特征组合相一致。 通过特征和覆盖面分析,我们量化了这些群体的规模和组织结构,表明它们在各类别之间差别很大,并突出了开放和封闭级方案类别之间的差异。 第二,我们表明,这些潜在的群体是紧凑而有效的: 它们的结合保持了强大的多级PoS分类性能,在被搁置的数据上它们保持稳定,同时仍然显示出相关类别之间的重叠.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Probing classifiers have long been used to test what linguistic information neural language models encode in their representations ( Conneau et al., 2018 ; Belinkov, 2022 ) . Prior work shows that lower layers capture morpho-syntactic information such as PoS , while higher layers encode more abstract semantic and discourse properties ( Tenney et al., 2019a ; Tenney et al., 2019b ; Hewitt and Manning, 2019 ; Rogers et al., 2020 ) . However, probing accuracy alone is limited: control tasks ( Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ) and information-theoretic critiques ( Pimentel et al., 2020 ) show that probes can fit arbitrary mappings, and that recoverability does not imply use. We share this concern, but shift the focus from what information is present to how it is organised at the level of individual sparse latents.
blocks.zh: 探险分类器长期以来被用于测试语言信息神经语言模型在其表达式中的编码(Conneau等人,2018年;Belinkov,2022年). 之前的研究表明,下层捕捉摩尔语-合成信息如PoS ,而更高层编码了更多的抽象语义和话语属性(Tenney等人,2019a;Tenney等人,2019b;Hewitt和Manning,2019;Rogers等人,2020年). 然而,仅探测准确性是有限的:控制任务(Hewitt and Liang, 2019)和信息理论批评(Pimentel et al., 2020)表明探测器可以适应任意绘图,可回收性并不意味着使用. 我们同意这一关切,但将重点从现有信息转移到如何在个别稀有潜伏层组织信息。

blocks.en: A growing body of work studies mechanistic interpretability in LLMs Sharkey et al. (2025) . Within this area, SAE s map dense activations to high-dimensional sparse vectors whose units are intended to be more monosemantic and interpretable ( Bricken et al., 2023 ; Cunningham et al., 2023 ) . Subsequent work has improved SAE training through scaling ( Templeton et al., 2024 ) and TopK activations ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , and released open SAE suites for widely used base models ( Lieberum et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) . These studies often identify latents aligned with intuitive concepts, using top-activating examples or automated natural-language explanations, but provide limited evidence on how theoretically motivated linguistic categories are represented in latent space.
blocks.zh: 在LLMs Sharkey等人(2025年)中,越来越多的工作研究是机械解释。 在这一区域范围内,SAE将密集的激活图映射到高维度的稀疏矢量上,其单位意在更加单一和可解释(Bricken等人,2023年;Cunningham等人,2023年)。 随后的工作通过规模化改进了SAE培训(Templeton等人,2024年)和TopK激活(Gao等人,2025年),并为广泛使用的基础模型发布了开放的SAE套房(Lieberum等人,2024年;He等人,2024年). 这些研究往往利用上动例或自动自然语言解释,找出与直观概念相一致的潜伏物,但提供有限证据,说明理论上激发的语言类别如何在潜伏空间中体现。

blocks.en: Recent work also questions whether SAE latents behave as genuinely monosemantic features. Kantamneni et al. (2025) find that probes trained on SAE latents do not consistently outperform simple baselines across 113 113 binary classification tasks, while SAEBench ( Karvonen et al., 2025 ) shows that gains on standard SAE proxy metrics often do not transfer to downstream performance. Still, SAE s remain useful tools for probing LM knowledge and behaviour Dupre la Tour and Mossing (2025) ; Fraser-Taliente et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 最近的工作还质疑SAE潜伏体是否具有真正的单一语义特征。 Kantamneni等人(2025年)发现,在SAE潜伏物方面受过训练的探测器在113项113次二进制分类任务中,不能一贯地超过简单基线,而SAEBench(Karvonen等人,2025年)表明,标准SAE代理度量的增益往往不会转移到下游性能. 尽管如此,SAEs仍然是探索LM知识和行为Dupre la Tour和Mossing(2025年);Fraser-Taliente等人(2026年)的有用工具。

blocks.en: Closer to our work, Marks et al. (2025) use SAE features to construct interpretable causal circuits for syntactic phenomena such as subject–verb agreement, suggesting that morpho-syntactic information is at least partly recoverable from SAE space. At the same time, Engels et al. (2025) show that not all language model features are well captured by single linear directions. Existing linguistic analyses of SAE s have mainly focused on isolated phenomena, such as subject–verb agreement, or broad properties such as language identity. We address the open question of whether and how classical morpho-syntactic categories are encoded by latents, using PoS as a controlled testbed beyond the binary probing regime explored by prior work.
blocks.zh: 更接近于我们的工作,Marks等人(2025年)使用SAE特性来构建可解释的因子电路,用于像主题-动词协议这样的合成现象,这表明morpho-syntic信息至少可以部分地从SAE空间中恢复. 同时,Engels等人(2025年)显示,并非所有语言模型特征都很好地被单线性方向所捕捉. SAEs的现有语言分析主要集中于孤立现象,如主题-动词一致,或语言认同等广义属性. 我们讨论了一个尚未解决的问题,即古典的morpho-yntractic分类是否以及如何被潜伏物编码,将PoS作为二进制检验制度之外的受控检验数据,以前的工作探索过。

blocks.en: 3 Method and Materials
blocks.zh: 3 方法和材料

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We conducted our experiments on two datasets: a naturally occurring corpus and a small controlled dataset constructed for targeted evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们在两个数据集上进行了实验:一个自然发生的实体和一个为目标明确的评估而建造的小型控制数据集。

blocks.en: The GUM treebank. For the naturally occurring data, we selected the UD English GUM treebank ( Zeldes, 2017 ) , annotated following the Universal Dependencies scheme. 2 2 2 https://universaldependencies.org/ We chose this treebank for its representativeness across diverse textual genres (academic, blog, legal, news, social, wiki, etc.), its medium size (14,353 sentences, 252,284 tokens), and its complete coverage of the 17 Universal PoS tags. The training split was used as the discovery set, while the test split was kept held out and used only to evaluate whether discovered activations remain active on unseen tokens of the corresponding PoS categories.
blocks.zh: GUM树库. 关于自然出现的数据,我们选择了UD英文GUM树库(Zeldes,2017年),该树库按照通用附属物方案附加说明。 我们选择这个树库是因为它具有不同文字流派(学术,博客,法律,新闻,社会,维基等)的代表性,它的中等尺寸(14,353句,252,284个符),以及它完全覆盖了17个通用的PoS标记. 训练分裂被用作发现设定,而测试分裂则被保留,仅用于评价发现的激活是否仍然活跃在对应的PoS类别的隐形标志上.

blocks.en: Controlled dataset. To complement the naturally occurring data, we constructed a small controlled dataset of 180 lexical items to verify whether latents associated with specific PoS tags activate systematically in minimal, grammatically well-formed sentences. The dataset focuses primarily on nouns and verbs. For nouns, we selected 160 items spanning multiple semantic categories (e.g., mammals, birds, flowers, vehicles, etc.), evenly split between animate and inanimate referents. Each noun was instantiated in singular and plural form within neutral templates, including impersonal constructions such as There is a dog and transitive constructions such as I see the dog and I have a dog . These templates vary determiner contexts, including indefinite articles, definite articles, and bare plurals. For verbs, we included 20 high-frequency verbs compatible with a minimal intransitive template ( I + verb , as in I walk ), balanced between 10 regular and 10 irregular past-tense forms, to limit the impact of morphological idiosyncrasies. All base sentences were augmented with two variants: one adding an adjacent adjective for noun sentences or adverb for verb sentences, and one appending punctuation to the augmented sentence. This allows us to assess whether additional PoS tokens introduce their own characteristic activations and whether these interact with those observed in the base sentence. All sentences were also instantiated in present and past tense to account for potential tense-driven effects.
blocks.zh: 受控数据集. 为了补充自然出现的数据,我们构建了一个由180个词典项目组成的小控制数据集,以核实与特定PoS标记相关的潜伏物是否在最小的,语法上完善的句子中系统激活. 数据集主要关注名词和动词. 对于名词,我们选择了160个涵盖多个语义类别(如哺乳动物,鸟类,花卉,车辆等)的物品,在动画和无动画的参考人之间均匀的划分. 每个名词在中立的模板中以单数和复数形式被即时化,包括非人性的构造,比如有一只狗和过渡性的构造,比如我看到狗和我有一只狗。 这些模板有不同的决定因素,包括无限期文章、明确文章和光复数。 对于动词,我们包括了20个高频动词,兼容一个最小的不便模板(I + 动词,如I walk ),在10个正态和10个不规则的过去语调形式之间保持平衡,以限制形态性异形的影响. 所有基句都增加了两个变体:一个是对名词句加一个相邻的形容词,另一个是对动词句加一个副词,还有一个是对加词句的附加语. 这使得我们可以评估附加的PoS符符是否引入了它们自己的特征激活,以及这些符符是否与基句中观察到的符符符相互作用. 所有判决在目前和过去的紧张状态中也立即进行,以考虑到潜在的紧张驱动效应。

blocks.en: 3.2 Processing Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 处理管道

blocks.en: In the following, we describe the processing pipeline to obtain SAE latent activations.
blocks.zh: 在下面,我们描述了获得SAE潜在激活的加工管道。

blocks.en: We experiment on LLaMA-3-8B . We employ the EleutherAI/sae-llama-3-8b-32x pre-trained model as our SAE. Both models are available on HuggingFace. The SAE model is trained and used via the Sparsify library. 3 3 3 https://github.com/EleutherAI/sparsify The library is designed to follow the SAE implementation described in Gao et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 我们在LLaMA -3 -8B实验 我们使用EleutherAI/sae-lama -3 -8b -32x 前训练模型作为我们的SAE. 两个型号均可在HuggingFace上获得. SAE模式通过Sparsify图书馆培训和使用。 3 3 3 https://github.com/EleutherAI/sparsify 该图书馆旨在跟踪Gao等人(2025年)描述的SAE执行.

blocks.en:
To extract token-level activations, we feed the raw sentence text to the model using its original subword tokenizer, and recover hidden state activations from the residual stream of layer 30 (last layer before the output) of the model. We encode such activations with the SAE to produce the sparse activation vectors for each subword. We obtain, for each subword, the fraction of SAE latents that fired on that subword, and their activation strength.
Then, we align subword tokens and UD surface forms via character-span overlap: For each UD token with character span [ t start , t end ) [t_{\mathrm{start}},\,t_{\mathrm{end}}) , all subword tokens whose span [ s , e ) [s,\,e) satisfies s < t end s<t_{\mathrm{end}} and e > t start e>t_{\mathrm{start}} are identified as overlapping. The leftmost such subword token is designated the anchor , and its SAE activations are adopted as the representation of the corresponding UD token. Note that we chose the leftmost subword because it is the position at which the UD token’s identity first becomes available to the model. Averaging over subwords may instead dilute category-bearing activations with continuation-piece activations.
This yields, for each token, a dense SAE activation vector that is composed of all SAE latents that fired on the token and their activation strength.
blocks.zh:
为了提取代号级激活,我们用其原始的子词代号器将原始句子文本输入模型,并从模型第30层(输出前的最后一层)的剩余流中恢复隐藏状态激活. 我们用SAE编码这种激活,为每个子词产生稀疏的激活矢量. 对于每个小词,我们获得发射该小词的SAE潜伏物的一小部分,以及它们的激活强度.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Our experiments are designed to assess not only whether PoS information is recoverable from SAE activations, but also how this information is organized in the latent space. In particular, we structure the analysis around the three research questions introduced in Section 1 . First, we test whether morpho-syntactic distinctions are explicitly available in the sparse activation space ( RQ1 ). Second, we investigate the organization of POS categories in the latent space ( RQ2 ). Third, we evaluate whether such organization is stable across splits and evaluation settings, and whether it supports general PoS classification ( RQ3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的实验不仅是为了评估PoS信息是否可以从SAE激活中恢复,而且是为了评估这种信息是如何在潜在空间中组织的。 特别是,我们围绕着第1节中提出的三个研究问题进行分析。 首先,我们测试在稀疏的激活空间(RQ1 )中是否明确存在鼠标-合成区分. 第二,我们调查潜在空间(RQ2)中的POS类别。 第三,我们评价这种组织在分裂和评价环境之间是否稳定,以及它是否支持一般方案支助分类(RQ3)。

blocks.en:
The experimental pipeline proceeds as follows. We first assess the linear recoverability of each PoS category with one-vs-rest probing classifiers (Section 4.1 ). We then localize PoS -relevant latent groups by combining feature salience, coverage, and compactness analyses (Section 4.2 ). Finally, we test the robustness of the selected groups on held-out data (Section 4.3 ).
This design separates recoverability, localization, and stability. Probing shows whether PoS information is present, while localization and validation assess how such information is organized in the latent space.
blocks.zh:
试验管道如下。 我们首先评估每类PoS的线性可回收性,并配有一Vs-res-resst检测器(第4.1节)。 然后,我们通过结合特征突出性、覆盖面和紧凑性分析,将PoS相关潜在群体本地化(第4.2节)。 最后,我们用搁置的数据检验选定小组的稳健性(第4.3节)。
这种设计将可回收性,本地化,稳定性分别出来. 测试显示是否存在PoS信息,而本地化和验证则评估这些信息如何在潜在空间中组织。

blocks.en: 4.1 Recoverability of PoS Information (RQ1)
blocks.zh: 4.1 PoS信息的可回收性(RQ1)

blocks.en: We first test whether PoS distinctions are linearly recoverable from SAE activations. For each token in the GUM training split, we use the sparse SAE activation vector (cf. Section 3.2 ) as input representation and the gold UD PoS tag as supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们首先测试 PoS 区分是否从 SAE 激活中线性恢复。 对于GUM训练拆分中的每个标志,我们使用稀疏的SAE激活载体(参见第3.2节)作为输入表示,而黄金UD PoS标记作为监督.

blocks.en: We evaluate the one-vs-all setting using 5-fold cross-validation on the GUM Treebank Train split. For each PoS category, we train a binary classifier to distinguish tokens with that PoS from all other tokens. We train an L1-regularized logistic regression classifier (C = 0.1) using the liblinear solver, with balanced class weighting to account for label imbalance. The L1 penalty encourages sparse weight vectors, effectively performing feature selection and yielding interpretable models where most coefficients are driven to zero, given the high-dimensional nature of SAE latent spaces.

blocks.en: This allows us to assess the extent to which individual PoS distinctions are linearly recoverable from SAE activations.
blocks.zh: 这使得我们可以评估单个PoS区分在多大程度上可以从SAE激活中线性恢复.

blocks.en: 4.2 PoS Organization in Latent Space (RQ2)
blocks.zh: 4.2 后期空间的PoS组织(RQ2)

blocks.en: We next ask how the PoS information recovered by the probes can be localized in the space of SAE latents. To this end, we use the one-vs-rest classifiers introduced in Section 4.1 not only as predictive models, but also as feature-salience mechanisms.

blocks.en: 4.4 Controls and Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.4 控制和基线

blocks.en:
We also provide a set of controls and baselines that address possible confounds and contextualise the SAE results.
First, we perform a control experiment to test whether lexical identity (i.e., the specific word form, like the preposition of ) can act as a confound for the probing experiments. To estimate how much of the original performance can be attributed to memorisation, we re-run the probe but assign each word type a random UPOS label. A probe relying solely on word identity would fit the control labels as well as the real ones.
blocks.zh:
我们还提供了一套控制和基线,用以解决可能存在的混乱问题,并结合当地情况处理SAE结果。
首先,我们进行一个控制实验,以测试词学特征(即特定单词形式,如proposition of .)是否能够充当探测实验的困惑. 为了估计有多少原始性能可以归结于记忆,我们重新运行探测器,但给每个词都分配一个随机的UPOS标签. 仅依靠字词身份的探测器既符合控制标签,也符合真实标签。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 RQ1: Recoverability of PoS Information
blocks.zh: 5.1 RQ1: PoS信息的可回收性

blocks.en: Figure 2: One-vs-rest probing performance for each PoS . F1 scores are computed with 5-fold cross-validation on the GUM training split.
blocks.zh: 图2:每张PoS的1Vs-resst测试性能. F1分数在GUM训练分数上以5倍的交叉验证计算.

blocks.en: The one-vs-rest probing results show that PoS distinctions are consistently recoverable from SAE activations. As shown in Figure 2 , the binary classifiers achieve high F1 scores for most categories across the 5-fold cross-validation setting. This indicates that morpho-syntactic information is explicitly available in the sparse latent space.
blocks.zh: 单Vs-resst的检测结果显示,PoS的区分从SAE激活中始终可以恢复. 如图2所示,二进制分类器在5倍的交叉验证设置中,大多数类别都取得了较高的F1分数. 这表明,在稀疏的潜在空间里可以明确获得病原合成信息。

blocks.en: Performance, however, is not uniform across tags. Closed-class categories and low-variability labels (e.g., punctuation), are easier to recover, while more lexically heterogeneous or less frequent categories show lower scores. Interestingly, nouns and verbs are the best performing open PoS . This suggests that recoverability is affected both by the linguistic nature of the category and by its support.
blocks.zh: 然而,不同标签的性能并不统一。 闭类类和低可变性标签(如点球)较容易恢复,而逻辑上比较多样或较少的类别则显示分数较低. 有趣的是,名词和动词是最能表现的公开PoS. 这表明,可恢复性受到该类语言性质及其支持的影响。

blocks.en: Overall, these results answer RQ1 positively: SAE activations contain information that is predictive of PoS categories. At the same time, probing performance alone does not reveal how this information is organized within the SAE latent space.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果对RQ1的回答是肯定的:SAE激活包含对PoS类别具有预测性的信息. 同时,仅仅探测性能并不能揭示这种信息如何在SAE潜在空间内组织。

blocks.en: 5.2 RQ2: PoS -related Latent Groups
blocks.zh: 5.2 RQ2: 与 " PoS " 有关的 " 后人组 "

blocks.en: RQ2 asks whether the PoS information recovered by the probes is localized in restricted regions of the SAE latent space, and at what granularity. We report below the results of the three experiments introduced in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: RQ2询问探测器回收的PoS信息是否位于SAE潜在空间的限制区域,以及颗粒度如何。 兹将第4.2节提出的三项试验的结果报告如下。

blocks.en:
The coefficient-based salience analysis shows that the binary probes do not rely uniformly on the full SAE latent space. For each PoS category, only a subset of latents receives positive weight, indicating that the classifier uses information concentrated in category-specific groups of sparse features. At the same time, these groups are not single-latent representations: PoS distinctions are supported by multiple positively contributing latents, consistent with a distributed, but non-uniform, organization of morpho-syntactic information .
Figure 3 displays the number of non-zero coefficients for each one-vs-rest classifier. It emergers quite clearly that Open-class PoS have generally more non-zero latents, while Closed-class and Other-class have markedly less. 5 5 5 See Appendix B.2 for additional details.

blocks.en: 5.5 Linguistic analysis of SAE activations
blocks.zh: 5.5 对SAE激活进行语言分析

blocks.en: The results confirm a systematic association between SAE activations and PoS information. Overall, four main patterns emerge.
blocks.zh: 结果证实了SAE激活和PoS信息之间的系统联系. 总体而言,出现了四种主要模式。

blocks.en: Closed classes are more stable and compact. On the training set (Figure 2 ) and on the held-out treebank test set (Figure 6 ), Closed-classes consistently achieve higher Recall and F1-score. Note that these categories also require fewer latents in the coverage analysis (Figure 4 and Appendix B.2 , Figure 3 ). By contrast, x and sym exhibit the highest error rates in both experiments, likely due to their low support in the training data (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 封闭的班级比较稳定,比较紧凑. 在培训集(图2)和被搁置的树库测试集(图6)上,封闭班级始终实现更高的回调和F1-分数. 注意这些类别在覆盖范围分析中也需要较少的潜在因素(图4和附录B.2,图3)。 相比之下,x和sym在两个实验中都表现出最高的误差率,这可能是因为他们在培训数据方面的支持度较低(图2 ).

blocks.en: The compactness gradient we observe co-varies with the size and formal variability of each category’s type inventory. A category with a handful of invariant word forms can be covered by a small latent group with no category-level abstraction being involved, since a group of form-specific latents suffices. The controlled data support this reading: DET collapses to a single activation value where the determiner is invariably the (Figure 18 ), and acquires structure only where the a/an versus bare-plural alternation introduces formal variation (Figure 7 ). The compactness ordering should therefore be read primarily as a gradient in lexical variability rather than as direct evidence of graded abstraction.
blocks.zh: 我们观察到的紧凑度梯度与每个类别清单的大小和形式上的可变性相同。 少数变化无常的词组的类别可以由一个小的潜在群体涵盖,而不涉及类别层次的抽象,因为一个特定形式的潜在群体就足够了。 受控数据支持这种读法:DET崩溃为单一激活值,而确定者总是(图18),只有在a/a对光-plural交替引入正式变异(图7)时才能获得结构。 因此,紧凑性顺序应主要理解为法理可变性的梯度,而不是分级抽象的直接证据。

blocks.en: Open classes show broader and less selective activation patterns. Spurious co-activations are more frequent for open PoS classes, where the same lemma or morphologically related forms can serve different functions depending on context. For instance, adj tokens are mainly confused with noun , adv , and propn , reflecting attributive noun uses, adjective–adverb overlap, and nominal modification patterns. Similarly, adv shows diffuse co-activation with adp , noun , adj , sconj , and verb , suggesting that some adverb-associated latents capture positional or contextual cues rather than adverbial function alone. propn and noun also co-activate, consistent with their shared nominal distribution, while verb shows overlap with noun in homograph pairs e.g. to drink / the drink .
blocks.zh: 开放课显示更广泛且较少选择性的激活模式. 对开放的PoS课来说,纯洁的共活性更常见,在同一类的lemma或形态上相关的形式根据上下文可以发挥不同的功能. 例如,辅词主要与名词、adv和propn相混淆,反映了形容词的名词使用、形容词和动词的重叠以及名义上的修改模式。 类似地,adv显示与adp,名词,辅词,sconj,和动词的分散共动,暗示一些副词相关的潜伏物捕捉位置或上下文提示,而不是只捕捉旁听函数. propn和名词也具有共动性,符合其共同的名义分布,而动词在同源词对中显示与名词重合,如饮用/饮用.

blocks.en: Some off-diagonal patterns reflect annotation and lexical overlap, as well as syntagmatic properties. The strongest non-target activations are not random. intj shows high spurious activation rates across several categories, plausibly due to annotation conventions that assign heterogeneous forms such as like , well , or God to intj in pragmatic contexts. Similarly, sconj co-activates with adp and verb , reflecting lexical overlap between subordinating conjunctions and prepositions in English (e.g., by , after , since ) and broader positional regularities. These patterns suggest that the selected latents do not encode purely abstract PoS function, but also respond to surface form, lemma sharing and orthographic cues. Moreover, the Pos emerging out of the latent space are also defined in terms of their syntactic contexts. For instance, the adj latents strongly co-activate with noun reflecting the nature of adjectives as nominal modifiers.
blocks.zh: 一些非对角图案反映了注解和词典重叠,以及协同性. 最强的非目标激活不是随机的. intj 显示不同类别的高假激活率, 合理的原因是, 同样,sconj与辅词和动词共同激活,反映了副辅词合和英语预位(例如,通过.之后,自.)和更广泛的位置规律之间的语法重叠. 这些图案表明,所选的潜伏体并不编码纯粹抽象的PoS函数,而是对表面形态,lemma共享和整形提示的反应. 此外,从潜在空间中涌现出来的 " 机会 " 也根据其结合背景加以界定。 例如,附带的潜伏物与名词具有强烈的共动性,反映了形容词作为名义修饰物的性质.

blocks.en:
Controlled examples confirm additive and category-sensitive activations. Turning to the controlled dataset, Figure 7 confirms that, as new tokens are introduced into the sentence, their associated latents activate consistently within the latent groups characteristic of their PoS,
suggesting that PoS-specific latent activations are largely additive across tokens. For example, adding loyal to There is a dog triggers the activation of more latents associated with adj .
We observe that some latents of related PoS es are already present even without the corresponding words (e.g., adj for noun and adv for verb ), but the number of active ones corresponding to that category consistently grows when the word is included in the template.
blocks.zh:
受控制的例子证实了添加剂和对类别敏感的激活。 关于受控数据集,图7确认,随着在句子中引入了新的符号,其相关潜伏物在其PoS特征的潜在组内持续激活,
说明PoS特定的潜在活化物主要具有各种标志的添加剂。 例如,加入忠心有一条狗 触发更多潜伏物的激活 与附.
我们注意到,即使没有对应的单词(如名词的辅词和动词的辅词),相关PoS es的一些潜在存在,但当该单词被列入模板时,与该类别相对应的活性单词数量持续增加.

blocks.en: These findings show that PoS -related latent groups are stable and systematic, but not category-exclusive. Closed classes tend to yield compact and selective representations, whereas open classes involve broader latent groups that also capture lexical, morphological, and contextual regularities.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,与PoS相关的潜在群体是稳定和系统的,但并非排他性的。 封闭的班级往往产生紧凑和选择性的表述,而开放的班级则涉及更广泛的潜在群体,这些群体还抓住了词汇、形态和背景规律。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We used PoS categories as a controlled testbed to study how morpho-syntactic information is organized in SAE s. We show that PoS distinctions are consistently recoverable from sparse activations, and that each category is supported by a compact group of sparse features, whose size varies with the linguistic nature of the category. For Open-class PoS , these groups are more diffuse, with a larger number of active latents, while Closed-class ones have fewer active latents. A small union of these category-specific latents preserves strong multi-class classification performance, and the selected groups remain stable on held-out treebank data and largely additive on controlled examples.
blocks.zh: 我们使用PoS类作为受控测试台,研究如何在SAE s中组织morpho-yntatic信息. 我们显示,PoS的区别总是可以从稀疏的激活中恢复,每个类别都有一组稀疏特征的支持,其大小随该类别的语言性质而异。 对于开放级的PoS来说,这些群体更加分散,活动潜质数量较多,而封闭级的活跃潜质数量较少。 这些特定类别的潜在物组成的一个小联盟保留了强大的多类分类性能,选定的群体在被搁置的树库数据上保持稳定,在受控制的例子上基本添加剂。

blocks.en: Our results reveal that PoS are internally represented in LLMs as emerging sets of localizable but distributed features in latent SAE space. Moreover, analyses suggest that interpretability claims at the latent level should be evaluated against theoretically grounded category inventories rather than top-activating examples alone. At the same time, cross-category co-activations show that the identified latents partly track lexical, positional, and annotation-driven regularities, motivating future work on richer linguistic levels and typologically diverse languages.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,在LLMS中,PoS是作为潜在SAE空间中新兴的可本地化但分布式特征组合的内部代表。 此外,分析表明,在潜在层面的可解释性索赔应参照基于理论的类别清单加以评估,而不应仅以头动为例。 与此同时,跨类别共同活动表明,所查明的潜在因素部分地跟踪了词汇、位置和注释驱动的规律,激励今后在更丰富的语言层次和类型多样性语言方面的工作。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our study focuses on PoS categories as a controlled morpho-syntactic test case. While this choice allows us to rely on exhaustive and independently annotated labels, PoS tags capture only one level of linguistic abstraction. Future work should extend the analysis to finer-grained morphological features, dependency relations, semantic roles, and discourse-level phenomena, where latent organization may be recoverable in different ways.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究侧重于PoS类作为受控的摩尔氏综合测试案例. 虽然这个选择使我们能够依靠详尽无遗和独立的注解标签,但PoS标记只捕捉到语言抽象的一级. 今后的工作应扩大分析范围,使之包括较细的形态特征、依赖关系、语义作用和语义层面的现象,在这些方面,潜在的组织可以以不同的方式加以恢复。

blocks.en: We also analyze a single base language model, LLaMA -3-8B, and one publicly available SAE . The observed patterns may depend on the underlying model, the layer from which activations are extracted, the SAE training procedure, and the sparsity regime. Comparing multiple models, layers, and SAE variants would be necessary to assess how general these findings are.
blocks.zh: 我们还分析一个单一的基础语言模型,LLaMA -3-8B,以及一个公开的SAE. 观测到的模式可能取决于基本的模型、活化物提取的层、SAE训练程序以及痉挛系统。 有必要比较多个模型、层和SAE变体,以评估这些结果的概况。

blocks.en: Our localization procedure relies on linear probing coefficients as a salience signal. Although the use of ℓ 1 \ell_{1} -regularization encourages sparse and interpretable solutions, probe coefficients should not be interpreted as direct causal evidence. The identified latents are predictive of PoS categories, but further causal interventions would be needed to establish whether they are used by the model for morpho-syntactic processing.
blocks.zh: 我们的定位程序依赖于线性测试系数作为突出信号. 虽然使用l1\ell\%1}——规范化鼓励了稀少且可解释的解决方案,但探针系数不应被解释为直接的因果关系. 已查明的潜在物是对PoS类别的预测,但需要进一步的因果干预,以确定这些潜在物是否被模型用于模拟合成处理。

blocks.en: Finally, our controlled dataset is intentionally small and targets a restricted set of constructions, mainly involving nouns and verbs. It is useful for validating whether selected latent groups remain active in simple and independently constructed contexts, but it does not cover the full syntactic and lexical variability of English. Broader controlled datasets would allow a more systematic evaluation of how lexical ambiguity, word order, morphology, and sentence complexity affect PoS -related latent activations.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们控制的数据集是故意小的,并且针对一组限制的构造,主要涉及名词和动词. 用于验证选定的潜在群体是否仍然活跃在简单和独立构造的背景中是有用的,但它并不涵盖英语的全部合成和词典变异性. 较广泛的控制数据集可以更系统地评价词汇模糊性、词序、形态和句子复杂性如何影响PoS-相关潜在激活。

blocks.en: These results suggest that the layer choice do not drastically affect the degree to which PoS es are encoded into the SAE latents, and that the findings of the paper should hold across the whole model. Results on additional layers at the beginning and middle of the model stack show slight variation, but are also a clear indication that the conclusions from the paper hold also for layers other than the one analyzed. Individual POS categories reshuffle which latents they rely on across depth, but the total representational budget and per-category magnitudes remain stable. This supports our claim of layer-consistent POS structure with depth-wise redistribution rather than qualitative change.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,层层选择不会严重影响PoS es编码成SAE潜伏体的程度,论文的结论应贯穿整个模型。 在模型堆栈的起始和中间的额外层的结果表明略有差异,但也清楚地表明,纸上的结论对所分析的层之外的其他层也有保留。 个人POS类别有可能在深度范围内进行重组,但代表预算总额和每个类别的规模保持稳定。 这支持我们主张以深度再分配而不是质的变化来建立与层一致的POS结构.

blocks.en: A.2 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: A.2 实验设置

blocks.en:
All experiments were conducted using a GPU node equipped with 8 A100 80GB GPUs. Given the model sizes, only one GPU was sufficient to extract hidden representations from a layer and encode it with its corresponding SAE. The process takes roughly 0.16 GPU hours per layer.
The probing classifiers were implemented using SciKit-Learn. The library does not leverage GPUs, but allows parallelization across CPU cores. A single 5-fold cross-validation training/test run on the GUM Treebank training set requires roughly 4 hours using all CPU cores available.
blocks.zh:
所有实验均使用配备8台A100 80GB GPU的GPU节点进行. 鉴于模型大小,只有一个GPU足以从一层中提取隐藏的表示,并用相应的SAE编码. 这个过程大约每层需要0.16 GPU小时.
探测分类器使用SciKit-Learn进行。 该库不利用GPU,而是允许跨CPU核心的平行化. 在GUM Treebank训练集上进行单一的5倍交叉验证训练/测试需要使用所有可用的CPU核心大约4小时.

blocks.en:
The distributions for most PoS tags are highly stable across sentence types, with the three curves largely overlapping. A consistent exception is the noun tag: in both transitive constructions ( I have/had and I see/saw ), the red and green curves, corresponding to sentences containing an additional adjective, show a slight shift in the activation distribution relative to the blue curve. This suggests that the presence of an adjacent adjective marginally affects noun-associated latent activations, consistent with co-activation patterns
discussed in Section 5.5 ; similarly, aux in
Figure 16 displays two distinct peaks,
reflecting the alternation between the present have and past had forms across sentences, confirming latents’ sensitivity to surface form in PoS classes with relatively low token variability. By contrast, the verb tag in Figure 17 shows only a minor shift across sentence types, suggesting that verb-associated
latents are less sensitive to the surrounding syntactic context than noun-associated ones.

blocks.en:
We report an example of first-token activations confounds on the controlled dataset. All tested cases show the same behavior, but we report only one example for brevity.
We do the following: we prepend “1.” to all templates, e.g., “1. I saw the cute cat”, recompute activations, and compare pre-vs-post addition of the NUM + PUNCT . In Figure 19 we report the results for the “I see/saw a [ADJ] [NOUN]”. We observe that all latents that fire on PRON in the original sentence (the first token “I”) shift to the first token NUM .
